text:
maria: Quick heads up — seeing ~3x spike in fncall strict rejects in the console for prod routes. Quota alerts also firing. Anyone digging in?
aj: saw it too. looks correlated with canary of strict-validator. Rejects are mostly 'missing_field' on tool_response.payload.items. Might be from new model variant.
kevin: @aj can you paste an example invoke id / payload? I want to trace in telemetry.
aj: paste log snippet: ```json
{
  "invoke_id": "inv_0x9f2",
  "route": "/generate",
  "reject_reason": "schema_mismatch",
  "validator_version": "v2.1.0-canary",
  "payload_snippet": "{\"tool_response\": {}}"
}
```
sophia: Is the console treating strict rejects as 'errors' that increment quota? We intentionally decided only accepted invokes should bill against strict quota.
maria: Console shows them under 'validation rejections' and quota dashboard counts them in 'invoke attempts'. That's confusing.
kevin: Two parts: routing policy fallback vs billing attribution. My read: routing still counts attempt for rate-limit but billing should probably not increment usage if fncall aborted pre-exec. Need product input.
aj: Also telemetry missing validator_version tag in the reject metric. So can't filter canary easily. Example metric: `fncall.rejects.total{reason=schema_mismatch}` — missing `validator_version` label.
sophia: Proposed UX: in console, show a column 'reject_class' with tags (schema_mismatch, timeout, partial) and a toggle 'count towards quota' with per-route default. That way ops can decide.
maria: Good. Short-term: can we backfill labels in metric and strip rejects from billing for tomorrow's billing window? Also add an alert to stop canary if rates > threshold.
kevin: I can add validator_version tagging in the metrics emitter today. PR incoming. Need approvers: @sophia.
aj: I'll file an incident-like thread with sample invocations + canary config and pin to this.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: canary rollback triggered for validator v2.1.0-canary at 4356789400 :white_check_mark:
maria: Nice. Action items: kevin add tag, sophia add quota toggle mock in console, aj assemble sample set and bisection steps. I'll follow up with a short rollout policy doc.
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8123 — adds validator_version label to metrics and a boolean `validation_counted` for billing. Test: added unit + integration.
aj: Tests look good locally. Will run staging load.
sophia: I'll add UI mock by EOD and link in product board.
maria: Thanks. Keeping this thread as single source. :thumbsup:
